local_checks.invariant: Claims acted on are the claims covered by a verified signature from the issuer-selected key set
local_checks.result: getRawToken parses the unverified payload; ValidateAccessToken then runs jws.Verify over the same raw string with the issuer's JWKS and validates claims on that same parsed token, so verify and parse cannot diverge. kid/iss only select the validator and server-configured JWKS URL. alg is not pinned in this code; jwx binds verification to key type (library behaviour needs an execution check).

local_checks.invariant: Issuer, expiry/nbf and audience are enforced per validator
local_checks.result: Issuer matched against config; mismatch returns handled=false and no handler means Unauthenticated. jwxt.Validate enforces exp/nbf/iat with 5m skew; it does not require exp. Audience enforced only when configured and '*' disables it (deployment config).

local_checks.invariant: A token must not override trusted principal claims
local_checks.result: privateClaims strips iss/sub/aud/exp/nbf/iat/jti; sub re-added from the verified subject; mtls_* claims stripped on unary and stream paths. No override path found.

hardening: ValidateAccessToken takes the JWKS URL from the global _issuerConfigs[issuer] but audiences from s.config; two configs with the same issuer string would mix them. Use s.config.OAuth2Config.JWKSUrl.
Configured issuer is not lowercased while the token iss is; mixed-case config fails closed. Normalize both.
jwxt.Validate does not require exp: a signed token without exp never expires. Add WithRequiredClaim(exp) or document.
Audience check skipped when Audiences is empty or contains '*'.
Claim-validation failure message says 'token signature not valid'.
codes.NotFound is the 'no token' sentinel and could collide with a custom IValidator returning NotFound.
Unary interceptor does not nil-check the scoped container (stream does).
_issuerConfigs is an unlocked global map; safe only if all AddValidators calls finish before serving.
Signatures()[0] used for kid while jws.Verify accepts any signature; not exploitable.

local_checks.invariant: A NATS publisher must not become an application principal without passing the same authentication chain as a gRPC caller
local_checks.result: HandleRequest copies NATS headers (including Authorization) into outgoing gRPC metadata; the generated handler calls the *grpc.ClientConn that runtime/runtime.go dials to the service's own endpoint, so the call re-enters the server interceptor chain and the bearer in the NATS header is what gets validated.
